column7: structural half of dynamic-secret-kill-switch-revert-001/002 (#2698), and deliberately a DERIVED sweep rather than a per-function guard: it walks every non-test file under internal/core, internal/storage/store and server/ and asserts nothing calls the full-row UpdateDynamicSecretLease or UpdateDynamicSecretConfig, with exactly ONE named allowance (CreateDynamicSecretConfig's encrypted-DSN write, which is #2651's site and is moved by open PR #2675). It fails in BOTH directions -- a new caller appearing, and the allowance going stale -- so #2675 landing makes this test demand the allowance be dropped and both methods deleted. #2698 could not delete them itself without conflicting with #2675 in the same few lines. Companion TestDynamicSecretWrites_AreColumnScoped asserts the three new LocalStorage bodies are Where+Updates with no Save/Select("*") and that all three core entry points route through them
